slides.title: Executive Summary
slides.headline: Overall reserves increased GBP 7m to GBP 592m
slides.plain_text:
Executive Summary
Overall reserves increased GBP 7m to GBP 592m
Total reserve: GBP 592m
Quarterly movement: +GBP 7m
Ultimate claims: GBP 3,445.5m
The principal increases were Casualty +GBP 5m and Property +GBP 2m.
40 projection-method selections changed since 2024 Q4, concentrated in Casualty and Marine and Motor and Property.
Casualty deterioration is now more visible in recent accident years; claims emergence and uncertainty are highlighted more explicitly.

slides.title: Reserving Class Commentary
slides.headline: Principal class movements and drivers
slides.plain_text:
Reserving Class Commentary
Principal class movements and drivers
Casualty: strengthened GBP 5m. Deterioration in accident years 2022 to 2024 is increasingly visible; assumptions are responding.
Property: strengthened GBP 2m. Experience is within expectation; catastrophe exposure is monitored seasonally.
Motor: broadly flat in the quarter.
Marine: broadly flat in the quarter.

slides.title: Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
slides.headline: Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
slides.plain_text:
Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
Casualty deterioration is now visible in accident years 2022 to 2024; the pace of emergence is the key uncertainty for the next two quarters.
The annual projection-method roll has moved maturing accident years to Chain Ladder; early diagonals for the new accident year rely on expected loss ratios.
Claims inflation remains a watch item for the longer-tailed classes.

slides.title: Conclusion and Next Review
slides.headline: Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
slides.plain_text:
Conclusion and Next Review
Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
Casualty emergence is the principal theme of this review and has been reflected in modest strengthening of recent accident years.
This review has been prepared by the actuarial function for management and Board use. Selections reflect actuarial judgement applied to the data available at the valuation date; they will be reassessed at the next quarterly review.
Total reserve: GBP 592m
